theorems.name: FieldShift.progression_residue
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem progression_residue
    (h t r t0 j q : ℤ) (ht : h ∣ t) (hr : h ∣ r) :
    h ∣ (t0 + j * t - q * r) - t0

theorems.name: FieldShift.progression_no_wrap
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem progression_no_wrap
    (b t j : ℤ) (ht : 0 < t) (hj0 : 0 ≤ j) (hjb : j < b) :
    0 ≤ j * t ∧ j * t < b * t

theorems.name: FieldShift.progression_mod_representative
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem progression_mod_representative
    (b t j : ℤ) (ht : 0 < t) (hj0 : 0 ≤ j) (hjb : j < b) :
    (j * t) % (b * t) = j * t

theorems.name: FieldShift.progression_distinct_mod
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem progression_distinct_mod
    (b t i j : ℤ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hi : i ∈ Set.Ico 0 b) (hj : j ∈ Set.Ico 0 b) :
    Int.ModEq (b * t) (i * t) (j * t) ↔ i = j

theorems.name: FieldShift.odd_doubling_modEq_iff
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem odd_doubling_modEq_iff
    (b : ℕ) (hb : Odd b) (i j : ℕ) :
    Nat.ModEq b (2 * i) (2 * j) ↔ Nat.ModEq b i j

theorems.name: FieldShift.odd_doubling_distinct_mod
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem odd_doubling_distinct_mod
    (b : ℕ) (hb : Odd b) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < b) (hj : j < b) :
    Nat.ModEq b (2 * i) (2 * j) ↔ i = j

theorems.name: FieldShift.synchronized_differences_add

theorem synchronized_differences_add
    (h a a1 s : ℤ) (hfirst : h ∣ a1 - a) (hsecond : h ∣ s - a1) :

theorems.name: FieldShift.commuting_pair_integer_normal_form
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem commuting_pair_integer_normal_form
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (g d : G) (hcommute : Commute g d)
    {x : G} (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure ({g, d} : Set G)) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ, g ^ m * d ^ n = x

theorems.name: FieldShift.commuting_pair_card_le
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem commuting_pair_card_le
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] (g d : G) (hcommute : Commute g d) :
    Nat.card (Subgroup.closure ({g, d} : Set G)) ≤ orderOf g * orderOf d

theorems.name: FieldShift.closure_pair_eq_zpowers_of_power
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem closure_pair_eq_zpowers_of_power
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (g d : G) (v : ℕ) (hpower : g ^ v = d) :
    Subgroup.closure ({g, d} : Set G) = Subgroup.zpowers g

theorems.name: FieldShift.field_diagram_group_card_bound
theorems.exact_source_statement:
theorem field_diagram_group_card_bound
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] (g d : G) (v : ℕ)
    (hcommute : Commute g d) (hd : d ^ 2 = 1) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hpower : g ^ v = 1 ∨ g ^ v = d) :
    Nat.card (Subgroup.closure ({g, d} : Set G)) ≤ 2 * v
